About.Title: About
About.CardDescription1: Production of dynamic and responsive websites
About.CardDescription2: Wireframes and prototypes to represent the digital product
About.CardDescription3: Performance, search positioning and best practices
About.Description: Throughout my career, I have had the opportunity to work on various challenging projects that have allowed me to enhance my technical and communication skills. My experience includes developing highly responsive and intuitive user interfaces, utilizing the latest industry practices and technologies, as well as implementing automated testing to ensure software quality.

Experiences.Title: H&W Publishing
Experiences.Description: Development of high-converting landing pages and VSLs for an American company, focusing on performance, accessibility, and conversion optimization.
Responsibilities: Development and delivery of over 200 landing pages and VSLs using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Bootstrap 5, Next.js, and TypeScript.
Maintaining Lighthouse scores above 80 in performance, accessibility, and SEO.
Implementation of A/B Testing and backredirect strategies for CRO optimization.
Development of complete conversion flows with a focus on result-oriented UX.
Application of on-page SEO best practices and componentization with Next.js + TypeScript.

Experiences.Title: Freelancer
Experiences.Description: Development and delivery of web projects for various clients, encompassing educational platforms, B2B and e-commerce, with an emphasis on conversion, performance and maintenance.
Responsibilities: Development of more than 15 web projects using React.js, Next.js, Tailwind CSS and JavaScript.
Creation of a sales website for a cryptocurrency course (StartCrypto), focused on conversion and visual copy.
Development of an institutional website for a medical equipment company (LA Medic Rio), with an emphasis on credibility and local SEO.
Building a web platform with a dashboard for students (On Training), integrating a members area and content management.
Responsible for the complete cycle: requirements, design, development, deployment and maintenance.

Experiences.Title: Lumis
Experiences.Description: Development of responsive and accessible digital interfaces for corporate solutions, focusing on performance and multidisciplinary collaboration.
Responsibilities: Development of responsive and accessible interfaces using HTML5, CSS3, SASS, and JavaScript.
Creation and maintenance of a library of reusable components for visual consistency.
Performance optimization with Google Lighthouse and PageSpeed Insights.
Ensuring accessibility according to WCAG standards and applying on-page SEO.
Collaboration with multidisciplinary teams on the corporate DXP platform.

Experiences.Title: Lumis
Experiences.Description: Translation of UX/UI designs into interactive code and integration with CRM systems for lead capture.
Responsibilities: Creation of responsive layouts and translation of designs into code.
SEO implementation and development on the DXP platform.
Integration with HubSpot CRM for lead capture.

Experiences.Title: Go! Telecom
Experiences.Description: Monitoring and maintenance of network infrastructure, including hardware and software updates.
Responsibilities: Performance monitoring and maintenance of network infrastructure.
Hardware and software updates (switches and routers).

Feedback.Title: Feedback
Feedback.SubTitle: See what my clients and partners say about my work!
Feedback.TextIntro: Every project is unique, and my commitment is to deliver efficient, optimized, and well-structured solutions. See what they say about the experience of working with me.

Feedbacks.Name: Anderson Nascimento
Feedbacks.Text: Dear Bruno, thank you so much for developing my company's website. It is undoubtedly another dream come true for all of us. The website has been a success and extremely valuable.

Feedbacks.Name: Rodrigo Marques
Feedbacks.Text: Bruno is a great professional and managed to make my dream and goal come true for years! We talked, and he quickly understood the demand and what I needed. He got it right the first time and delivered the website without having to make any changes. It was exactly what I needed and wanted! Thank you Bruno for making my dream come true! We are in this together!

Feedbacks.Name: Thayane Fabiano
Feedbacks.Text: Working with Bruno at Lumis helped me a lot to understand more about development and become a better designer. His willingness to learn, collaborate, and dedication to delivering the best possible result left an excellent impression on me.

Feedbacks.Name: Luis Fernando
Feedbacks.Text: It is the fulfillment of a long-time wish; Bruno helped us understand the process between imagining and making it happen, and from there, it's all history. I'm very happy with the result!

Feedbacks.Name: Bruna Gomes
Feedbacks.Text: Bruno is a very dedicated and helpful professional. We worked together on several projects, where he demonstrated a lot of efficiency and agility, always delivering great work.

Feedbacks.Name: Daniel Clemente
Feedbacks.Text: I had the pleasure of working with Bruno when he was part of the Marketing team at Lumis. Bruno was always very helpful and showed mastery over what he did and said. With him, I was able to better understand development and how our area worked together.
